mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause acute kidney injury through different mechanisms; ibuprofen reduces renal perfusion via prostaglandin inhibition while foscarnet causes direct tubular toxicity, and NSAIDs may impair foscarnet clearance.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, maintain aggressive hydration, monitor renal function closely, use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration, and consider alternative analgesics.
